newsitem.title: USA: Harte, Scripps in $775 mln deal.
newsitem.headline: Harte, Scripps in $775 mln deal.

text.p: Harte-Hanks Communications Inc said Friday it will proceed with its previously announced divestiture of its newspaper and television operations to E.W. Scripps Co in a cash transaction worth $775 million.
When companies originally announced the divestiture on May 19, they said they preferred to make the sale as a Morris Trust transaction.

A spokesman said that through a Morris Trust transaction, it would have been able to split the company, put the assets it wanted to sell in the separate company and sell that in a tax-free transaction.
The company said, however, that new legislation prevents this action, so it will proceed with the sale on a cash basis.
The spokesman said it had planned to sell the assets for $600 million if had been a Morris Trust Transaction.
The company sait it expects to close the deal in the fourth quarter subject to approval by the U.S. Federal Communications Commission.
Harte-Hanks said it will derive 100 percent of its revenues from the direct marketing and shopper businesses once this sale is complete.
